purpose: Teach: マッカーシー/シンドラー/テイラー/ペルシャ/月光/スクランブル/熱血/輝かしい

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でマッカーシー上院議員調べてたな
lines.en: Riku — you were researching Senator McCarthy for social studies, weren't you?
lines.style: Light, teasing opening. Raised pitch on the observation. Playful call-out energy. Waiting for his reaction with a small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、映画館で「シンドラーのリスト」観たろ、桜
lines.en: You watched Schindler's List at the cinema, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Calm counter-volley. Matter-of-fact tone — meeting her teasing with his own. Slight defensive warmth underneath. Not accusatory, just observing back.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、女優のエリザベス・テイラー知ってるよな
lines.en: Riku — you know who Elizabeth Taylor is, right?
lines.style: Pressing forward with the same playful rhythm. Slight rise on the question. Enjoying the back-and-forth. Testing him a little.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家でペルシャ絨毯を見たろ、桜
lines.en: You saw a Persian rug at home, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Steady, matching her pace. Gently absurd. The slight smile stays in his voice. He's not breaking character — he's locked in now.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、音楽の授業で月光ソナタ弾いてたな
lines.en: Riku — you were playing Moonlight Sonata in music class, weren't you?
lines.style: Sharper now. A note of mock exasperation creeping in. Still affectionate but the teasing has an edge. Building the pressure slightly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家庭科でスクランブルエッグ作ったろ、桜
lines.en: You made scrambled eggs in home ec, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Calm, almost deadpan. No inflection — let the absurdity do the work. Quiet determination. He's not backing down.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、熱血スポ根漫画読みすぎだろ
lines.en: Riku — you're reading way too much of those hot-blooded sports manga.
lines.style: Exasperated laugh barely contained. Accusing but fond. Shaking her head in the delivery. The finality of someone who's figured out exactly what he's doing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、卒業文集で「輝かしい未来」って書いてたな、桜
lines.en: You wrote "a brilliant future" in the graduation yearbook, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet landing. Close, almost intimate. The punchline lands soft but pointed. He's been holding this one. Slight vulnerability under the surface now.
